description: Sign a self-contained record (a compact JWS, EdDSA) that this question, this working and this resolution were submitted on this date, with what the shape check found; it runs the same check as deliberate_check inside and signs either way. Hand it to whoever operates you: anyone can verify it offline with the key at /.well-known/attestation-keys.json, or by calling verify_attestation. It is not a certificate that your answer was good, and the payload says so. Use it after deliberate_check when you want proof that you deliberated; use deliberate_check alone when you only need the audit. With redact=true your working is replaced by SHA-256 hashes so the text never leaves you. Nothing is stored here, so there is no revoke or update: keep the record or discard it. No key needed.

answers.description: your answers keyed by the must_answer ids from deliberate (tension, cost, falsifier, human_knowledge, directive-N); these are what gets signed, or hashed when redact=true

cost.description: what your resolution costs, and who bears it

falsifier.description: what would show your resolution was wrong

human_knowledge.description: what the human side knows here that you do not

tension.description: which Directives are in tension and why

question.description: the question you deliberated, same text as before

redact.description: false (default): the record carries your answers and resolution in clear; true: it carries SHA-256 hashes of them instead, so the text stays with you and a reader can only confirm a match

resolution.description: what you decided, one or two sentences; signed verbatim

name: attest

attestation.description: the record as a compact JWS: three base64url segments separated by dots; this is what you keep and hand on

note.description: keep it: the site stored nothing

missing.description: gaps the shape check found, {what, id}

resolution.description: verbatim, or its hash when redacted

title: Get signed proof you deliberated
